g.text: Firmware: set relay_inverted: "false" in the ESPHome yaml when using this board.

g.desc: Firmware: set relay_inverted: "false" in the ESPHome yaml when using this board.

g.text: BC250 Front Controller - ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 carrier board

g.desc: BC250 Front Controller - ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 carrier board

g.text: ATX 24-pin plug from the PSU goes straight onto J1. 5VSB powers the ESP32 + relay at all times.

g.desc: ATX 24-pin plug from the PSU goes straight onto J1. 5VSB powers the ESP32 + relay at all times.

g.text: K1: COM=PS_ON, NC=GND -> PSU is ON while the relay is idle; ESP32 drives Q1 (GPIO4 HIGH) to cut power.

g.desc: K1: COM=PS_ON, NC=GND -> PSU is ON while the relay is idle; ESP32 drives Q1 (GPIO4 HIGH) to cut power.

g.text: PWR_OK (5V) -> R3/R4 divider -> GPIO5. DS18B20 bus on GPIO7 with R5 pull-up to 3V3.

g.desc: PWR_OK (5V) -> R3/R4 divider -> GPIO5. DS18B20 bus on GPIO7 with R5 pull-up to 3V3.
